name: ECHO LOOP
subtitle: Outrun your own echoes
promotionalText: Every five seconds, your past returns to chase you. Survive the loop, face elite echoes and bosses, and push your score higher.
description:
ECHO LOOP is a fast neon survival game built around one simple rule: your past comes back for you.

Move through the arena, collect shards, time your dash, and survive as recordings of your previous movement become dangerous echoes. The longer you last, the denser and more unpredictable the loop becomes.

FEATURES
• Easy to learn, one-finger movement
• Echoes that replay your previous path
• Classic, Hunter, Mirror, Phase and boss encounters
• Arena events, pulse hazards and escalating stages
• Dash, combo, shard and score systems
• Free Signal Zero seasonal progression
• Missions, achievements, cosmetics and profile progression
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• Optional rewarded ads for a revive
• Remove Ads and Premium Neon non-consumable purchases
• Haptics, reduced-motion support and adaptive visual effects

Every run creates the challenge for the next one. How long can you outrun yourself?
